zh-CN.title: 独立开发版、数据重置与稳定性改进

sections.title: 默认命令与语言
items: 首次使用仅创建一个默认分类和 echo Hello Tabby 示例命令，默认收藏、不置顶
默认分类、示例命令名称和说明按 Tabby 当前界面语言初始化，后续切换语言不会改写用户内容
升级和重新安装保留已有命令库，包括用户主动清空的命令库，不会重复添加示例

sections.title: 重置插件数据
items: 在“恢复默认配置”弹窗中新增“重置插件数据”入口，展示实际数据目录，并要求二次确认和勾选不可撤销操作提示
重置会清除当前插件的命令、分类、触发器、设置、备份、日志、统计和缓存，再按当前语言创建默认分类和示例命令
正式版与 Dev 仅重置各自数据，不卸载插件，不影响 Tabby 配置、其他插件或保存在其他位置的导出文件；执行中的命令、更新安装和不安全路径会阻止重置

sections.title: 独立 Dev 开发版
items: 新增可与正式版并存的本地 Dev 包，独立隔离数据、设置入口、事件、快捷键配置和样式，并使用带 D 标记的图标
新增 Dev 构建、安装、安装后重启和数据清理命令，正式版与 Dev 使用相同的默认设置和执行逻辑
Dev 从正式包读取更新信息和历史，缓存与检查更新偏好独立；版本比较忽略本地 -dev.local 后缀，更新 Dev 需重新安装本地源码，不会在线覆盖为正式包

sections.title: 并发与保存修复
items: 正式版与 Dev 抽屉同时打开时，Ctrl+Enter 只交给最上层抽屉处理，避免执行被遮挡抽屉中的命令
重置期间阻止读取未完成的数据状态，并使旧窗口、待保存内容、未完成的导入和更新请求失效，避免旧数据在重置后被写回
写锁改用独立标识，避免清理过期锁时误删其他窗口的新锁；执行结束后可在写锁被占用时释放自身记录，避免持续阻塞重置
设置保存失败时恢复已保存的值并显示原因；导入和恢复默认配置失败时保留确认状态，不再显示成功提示

sections.title: 本地安装、清理与文档
items: 本地安装登记实际插件版本并同步已有 npm 锁文件，修复 file:node_modules/... 自引用导致的卸载异常，同时备份原安装记录
Dev 清理命令支持回车确认后正常关闭、清理并重启，使用独立后台进程继续操作并记录结果；Tabby 原本已关闭时只清理，不自动启动
修复关闭过程中短暂出现新 Tabby 进程就立即报错的问题：等待其自然退出并连续确认进程为空；超时不清理，不强制关闭新进程，并补充父 PID 和进程类型诊断
同步中英文 README、Dev 使用说明、常用开发命令和 npm ci / npm install 区别，并补充数据隔离、并发、安装清理和卸载回归测试

zh-CN.notice: 更新后请完整重启 Tabby；普通升级不会清空已有命令库。“重置插件数据”和 Dev 清理不可撤销，请先导出需要保留的命令和配置。

en.title: Separate Dev builds, data reset, and stability improvements

sections.title: Default commands and language
items: Create just one default category and an echo Hello Tabby example command on first use, favorited but not pinned
Initialize the default category, example name, and description in Tabby's current interface language without rewriting user content when the language changes later
Preserve existing command libraries during upgrades and reinstalls, including intentionally emptied libraries, without adding the example again

sections.title: Reset plugin data
items: Add Reset plugin data to the Restore defaults dialog, showing the actual data directory and requiring a second confirmation page with an acknowledgement of permanent deletion
Clear the current plugin's commands, categories, triggers, settings, backups, logs, statistics, and caches, then recreate the default category and example command in the current language

Reset only the selected stable or Dev channel without uninstalling plugins or affecting Tabby configuration, other plugins, or exports stored elsewhere; running commands, update installation, and unsafe paths block the reset

sections.title: Separate Dev builds
items: Add a local Dev package that can coexist with stable, with separate data, settings entries, events, shortcut configuration, and styles, plus an icon marked with D
Add commands to build, install, install and restart, and clear Dev data; stable and Dev share the same default settings and execution logic

Read Dev update information and history from the stable package while keeping caches and update check preferences separate; ignore the local -dev.local suffix in version comparisons and update Dev by reinstalling local source instead of replacing it with the stable package online

sections.title: Concurrency and saving fixes
items: Route Ctrl+Enter only to the topmost drawer when stable and Dev are both open, avoiding command execution in the covered drawer
Block reads of incomplete reset data and invalidate old windows, pending saves, unfinished imports, and update requests so that obsolete data cannot be written back after a reset

Use unique writer lock identifiers so stale lock cleanup cannot remove another window's new lock; release completed execution records even when a writer lock is held, preventing them from indefinitely blocking a reset
Restore saved settings and display the reason when saving fails; keep import and Restore defaults confirmations available after a failure instead of reporting success

sections.title: Local installation, cleanup, and documentation
items: Register actual locally installed versions and synchronize existing npm lockfiles, fixing uninstall failures caused by file:node_modules/... self-references while backing up previous installation records

Let the Dev cleanup command request normal shutdown, clear data, and restart after Enter confirmation, using a detached worker with result logs; if Tabby is already closed, only clear data without starting it

Fix immediate cleanup failure when a new Tabby process appears briefly during shutdown: wait for it to exit naturally and confirm consecutive empty process checks; preserve data on timeout, never force-close new processes, and log parent PIDs and process types

Synchronize the Chinese and English READMEs, Dev instructions, common development commands, and the npm ci / npm install comparison, with regression coverage for data isolation, concurrency, installation, cleanup, and uninstall

en.notice: Fully restart Tabby after updating; normal upgrades preserve existing command libraries. Reset plugin data and Dev cleanup cannot be undone. Export any commands and configuration you need to keep first.
